newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius index edges up after finance min named.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius index edges up after finance min named.

text.p: The Mauritius bourse share index edged up by 0.23 points to 325.77 on Friday, with traders cautious after the appointment of new finance minister Vasant Bunwaree late on Wednesday, brokers said.
Volume transacted totalled 8.42 million rupees on 710,587 shares from 9.54 million rupees on 569,558 shares on Wednesday.
Stocks were mixed and the semdex was pushed up by rising shares of market heavyweights State Bank of Mauritius, conglomerate Rogers and hotel firm Sun Resorts, brokers said.
State Bank gained 10 cents to an all time high of 8.90 rupees on 224,600 shares, Rogers rose 50 cents to 91.50 rupees on 3,093 shares and Sun Resorts gained 30 cents to 34.90 rupees on 1,196 shares.
Mauritius Commercial Bank was unchanged at 73 rupees on 9,249 shares while British American Insurance was unchanged at 7.30 rupees on 52,000 shares.

In the investment sector, Promotion And Development (PAD) fell by 90 cents to 14.10 rupees on 5,100 shares and General Investment Development Company (preference) lost 10 cents to 5.20 rupees on 101,993 shares.
